files.apps/desktop/src/main/library/public-fet: URL import: fetches the page the user typed, public addresses only (undici with a lookup that refuses private ranges)
files.apps/desktop/src/main/server-api.ts: desktop main talks to its own loopback server on 127.0.0.1
files.apps/desktop/src/main/updates-service.ts: electron-updater checks GitHub Releases for a new version
voice chat: tests the OpenAI key and mints short-lived Realtime client secrets with it; the key goes to api.openai.com only
files.apps/extension/src/app/background/connec: extension talks to the desktop app on 127.0.0.1
files.apps/extension/src/app/offscreen/voice.t: voice chat: the offscreen session posts the WebRTC offer to OpenAI (api.openai.com, or the test server in test builds) and asks the app on 127.0.0.1 for a client secret
files.apps/extension/src/features/voicechat/Vo: the options card asks the app on 127.0.0.1 whether an OpenAI key is set
files.apps/extension/src/features/voicechat/mi: voice chat: asks the Speak Kit app on 127.0.0.1 for a short-lived OpenAI client secret and for whether a key is set
files.apps/extension/src/features/voicechat/re: voice chat: trades the WebRTC offer for the answer at OpenAI, authorised by the client secret only
files.packages/cli/src/client.ts: the speakkit command and its MCP server talk to the desktop app on 127.0.0.1 only
files.packages/engine/src/worker.ts: kokoro-js downloads the model files from Hugging Face on first use

hosts.api.github.com: update check reads the latest release (electron-updater feed and the manual check)
hosts.api.openai.com: voice chat: the desktop app tests the OpenAI key and mints short-lived Realtime client secrets with it (the key goes nowhere else); the extension connects to the Realtime API with that secret only
hosts.chromewebstore.google.com: link opened in the user's browser to install the extension
hosts.github.com: release page opened in the user's browser
hosts.huggingface.co: dictation: packages/engine/src/stt/download.ts fetches the speech model and the voice-gate model on first use, resumable and checked against a SHA-256; nothing else is sent
hosts.platform.openai.com: link opened in the user's browser to add credit to their OpenAI account
hosts.speakkit.app: links to the product site opened in the user's browser
